title: A dropped source table fails the whole ingestion pipeline until the table is removed from it

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: MySQL 8.4.13 and Oracle Free 23.26.3, standard gateway, one run each

symptom: Oracle: the first update after the DROP, with no change to that table, COMPLETED with no error. After changes reached the gateway, the next ingestion update FAILED at analysis: "[INGESTION_GATEWAY_TABLE_DROPPED] Source table <catalog>.<schema>.<table> has been dropped on source", and "A new pipeline update will not be created". MySQL: every ingestion update FAILED at analysis with "Failed to resolve flow" for the dropped table's flow.
cause: Not established: the pipeline still plans the dropped table's flow.
effect: Every table in the pipeline stops updating until the dropped table is removed.
fix: Remove the dropped table from the ingestion pipeline. The Oracle pipeline ran again after that; the MySQL updates failed until it was removed.
notes: One run each. The Oracle update that followed the drop completed, so the error appears only after a change reaches the gateway.
